clips.title: The story
paras: Uthek the Wise of the Gelkis says you still have more to prove, and that for now the Gelkis will take on the Magram without your help. The earth has whispered to Uthek of draenethyst, and you are sent far away to the Swamp of Sorrows for a shard held by the lost one Ongeku.

After Stealing Supplies, Uthek the Wise tells you that your next undertaking lies a long way off. Those who listen hear many secrets in the earth, and one Uthek has heard is of a red crystal called draenethyst, newly arrived in this land and brought from a place of flying mountains and ruling demons. A shard of it, Uthek says, will make the magic strong. The lost one Ongeku holds a shard in the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. When you return, Uthek will look for proof that the Gelkis can still call you friend.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have more to prove, and your next task will take you far, so for now the Gelkis will fight the Magram without you.

The earth whispers many secrets to those who listen. One secret I hear is of a red crystal. It is called draenethyst, and it is new to our earth. It comes from a place where mountains fly, and where demons rule.
Bring me a shard of draenethyst, and it will make my magic strong! The shard is in a place called the Swamp of Sorrows, held by the lost one Ongeku.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Show me you are a friend of the Gelkis, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this is the shard of which the earth whispered. I can feel strong magic in it! I will use this magic against the enemies of the Gelkis.
You have done one more task for us, friend. Maybe soon, we will call you friend.
